title: Top3D.ai arena adds Hitem3D v3, Meshy 7, and Tripo P2.0
summary: Top3D.ai announces Hitem3D v3.0 preview and Meshy 7 in the main arena plus Tripo P2.0 in the low-poly arena, using the same prompt pool and max settings ranked by blind battles at top3d.ai/arena.
question_it_answers: Which image-to-3D models did Top3D.ai add to its blind comparison arena?

claims.text: Hitem3D v3.0 preview and Meshy 7 joined the main Top3D.ai arena with matched prompts and settings.
claims.evidence:
Hitem3D v3.0 (Preview) - Main Arena 
⚫ Meshy 7 - Main Arena
